Name: Farm Animal Choices
Author: shivaGuy
Description:
Marnie, don't make me reset the shop for all them Blue Chickens!

[b]Farm Animals Choices[/b] is a mod that disables randomised animal purchase, and add all animals (vanilla only) to the Marnie's shop.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11850/11850-1651205291-669575962.png[/img]

I really liked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11551]Livestock Choices[/url] mod, but it altered the game progression. So I made this mod as an [b]alternative[/b] with an optional [i]Progression Mode[/i] which ensures that animals will get unlocked according to the progression set by the game.



[u][size=5][b]Updates[/b][/size][/u]

[list]
[*]1.1.0 -- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11539]Bulk Animal Purchase[/url]
[*]1.0.0 -- Intial Release
[/list]
[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Run the game using SMAPI.﻿
